frozen_invariants.controller: fixed zero-residual PD with zero desired velocity and descriptor gains/caps
frozen_invariants.integer_emission: ties-to-even; exact emitted arrays are the offline gate

source_roles.v9_complete_clip: the only admissible 801-knot initialization and whole-horizon tracking reference
source_roles.v7_prior: joint-position tracking/safety prior on exact frames 238..249 only; never a complete trajectory, splice, initialization or independently admissible candidate
source_roles.current_descriptor: the exact R113 structural, material and fixed-PD identity used for joint order and limits
source_roles.legacy_descriptor: kinematic byte lineage used by V7/V9; its bodies, joints, actuators, effectors and exclusions must equal the current descriptor

time_grid.endpoint_policy: q at knots 0 and 800 is fixed byte-equivalent to V9 after emission

root_configuration_per_knot: three-dimensional SO(3) tangent perturbation in radians about the V9 xyzw root quaternion
root_velocity_per_knot: engine-world linear xyz in metres per second
engine-world angular xyz in radians per second
root_acceleration_per_knot: engine-world linear xyz in metres per second squared
engine-world angular xyz in radians per second squared
decision_variables.joint_velocity_per_knot: 23 descriptor-ordinal velocities in radians per second
decision_variables.joint_acceleration_per_knot: 23 descriptor-ordinal accelerations in radians per second squared
decision_variables.orientation_map: R_WB = Exp(delta_theta_W) * R_WB_V9; use the principal SO(3) branch and require norm(delta_theta_W) <= pi/2

kinematic_equalities.stencil_semantics: forward on contact entry; backward on exit; centered otherwise; entry precedence
kinematic_equalities.linear_and_joint_velocity: v = H(q) at every knot using the frozen 60 Hz two-sample stencil
kinematic_equalities.angular_velocity: omega_k is the same stencil coefficient times principal Log(R_right * R_left^T) in engine-world coordinates
kinematic_equalities.acceleration: a = H(v) at every knot using the same frozen stencil
kinematic_equalities.working_state_policy: q, v and a remain explicit variables joined by exact nonlinear equality constraints; none is independently emitted

hard_constraints.contact_modes: byte-identical V9 801x2 schedule with all four heel/forefoot points retained
active_contact: position and velocity diagnostics use the frozen V9 contact kernel
hard_constraints.colliders: all 19 exact descriptor colliders at every knot, minimum height -2 micrometres after emission
hard_constraints.joint_rom: all 23 current descriptor soft limits intersected with any stricter V9 trajectory-closure joint bound
hard_constraints.joint_velocity: absolute emitted velocity no greater than floor(descriptor maximum times 2500/10000) for every joint and knot
hard_constraints.root_vertical_velocity: absolute emitted engine-world Y velocity no greater than 200060 micrometres per second
hard_constraints.orientation_chart: principal SO(3) branch with tangent norm no greater than pi/2; this is a solver-domain restriction, not a relaxed acceptance limit
hard_constraints.source_endpoints: emitted root pose and all 23 emitted joint positions at knots 0 and 800 equal V9 exactly
hard_constraints.public_limit_margins: none; continuous feasibility never substitutes for the exact emitted audit

terms: sum squared V7 joint-position error over the 61 differing cells in frames 238..249 divided by the exact V9 baseline 17142428727 microradians squared
mean squared full-horizon configuration displacement from V9 after component scaling
mean squared 60 Hz acceleration displacement from the stencil-derived V9 acceleration after component scaling

normalization.v7_prior: exact squared integer distance divided by 17142428727
normalization.root_translation: divide displacement by the frozen V9 root-variable scale 0.02 metres
normalization.root_orientation: divide SO(3) tangent displacement by the frozen V9 angular/joint-variable scale 0.1 radians
normalization.joint_position: divide displacement by the frozen V9 joint-variable scale 0.1 radians
normalization.root_linear_acceleration: divide displacement from V9 acceleration by 72 metres per second squared = 0.02 * 60^2
normalization.root_angular_and_joint_acceleration: divide displacement from V9 acceleration by 360 radians per second squared = 0.1 * 60^2
normalization.mean_policy: take the arithmetic mean inside each full-horizon term before equal-weight summation

objective.termination_priority: first exact emitted PASS with exact integer nonzero V7 progress; do not continue optimizing for a better score

quantization_and_emission.root_position: metres multiplied by 1000000 to signed int64 micrometres
quantization_and_emission.root_orientation: map the SO(3) matrix through the frozen canonical xyzw matrix_to_quaternion function, multiply by 2^30 and ties-to-even round
quantization_and_emission.root_yaw: decompose emitted and source-V9 quaternions with frozen XZY semantics, wrap their difference to [-pi,pi], add that delta to the continuous source-V9 root_yaw branch, multiply radians by 1000000 and ties-to-even round
quantization_and_emission.root_yaw_branch_policy: nearest continuous V9 branch; required to preserve frozen unwrapped root-yaw velocity semantics and never a post-emission repair
quantization_and_emission.joint_position: radians multiplied by 1000000 to signed int64 microradians
quantization_and_emission.dependent_arrays: recompute root/joint velocity, root yaw velocity, FK effectors, center of mass and every collider sample from emitted pose; copy only V9 contacts, modes, phase and reference-frame identity
quantization_and_emission.solver_private_warm_start_cache: on exact PASS only, serialize q/v/a plus emitted-array hashes into one external transient R115 cache with no corpus, controller, runtime or acceptance authority
quantization_and_emission.warm_start_retention: retain only through the separately authorized inverse-dynamics stages, then delete; delete immediately on R115 failure

tracking_progress_gate.scope: joint_position_urad at exact complete-clip frames 238..249 against the hash-bound passing V7/R47 case
tracking_progress_gate.required_directional_dot: sum((V7 - V9) * (emitted - V9)) must be greater than zero using exact integers
tracking_progress_gate.required_distance_change: sum((V7 - emitted)^2) must be strictly less than 17142428727 using exact integers

required_conditions: all frozen V9 contact diagnostics pass
all collider, ROM, root-velocity and joint-velocity diagnostics pass at unchanged public limits
emitted endpoints and immutable arrays remain byte-exact
tracking_progress_gate passes with at least one changed joint-position cell
no NaN, infinity, overflow, branch ambiguity or post-rounding repair occurs

execution_budget.solver_family: deterministic sparse sequential quadratic programming with frozen analytic or symmetric finite-difference local Jacobians and OSQP subproblems

forbidden_reactions: change a public limit or safety threshold
add a margin, grace period, settling phase or velocity reset
sweep objective weights, line-search schedules or solver settings
run another KTO solve, a PhysX scene, all-17, V19 or training

decision.next_smallest_action: execute exactly one R115 in-memory quantization-aware KTO solve under this frozen contract; emit metrics only and run no PhysX scene
